
---
Code signing: ClipItTo uses the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org) for code signing of its Windows files. Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by SignPath Foundation. Until the first signed release the Windows files are unsigned, and Windows shows "Unknown publisher"; see the [code signing policy](https://github.com/NiMiZ/ClipItTo/blob/main/README.md#code-signing-policy).
